heuristic.applicability: Prefer when target_object is red, red is visibly displaced from its demonstrated initial patch, and red plus the supplied buffer are plausibly reachable. It remains applicable through supervised release and blue-acquisition overlap. Resolve red from the latest causal observation at each 8-step replan.

handoff.entry_conditions: Open clear gripper with red observed and reachable, or a supervised intermediate approach/hold/carry/lower/release state. target_object is red, successor_object blue, and buffer_pose_world denotes the free area.
handoff.exit_conditions: Core exit is red stationary near buffer with open gripper and clear TCP. Later overlap exit may have red stationary and blue closed on and beginning to lift.
handoff.failure_signatures: Red fails to co-move after close, remains elevated/follows TCP after opening, lands outside buffer, or becomes unobservable; IK has significant residual/limit contact; blue is disturbed before red settles.
handoff.overlap_role: Every assigned action is retained. The 210-230 action tails cover red lowering/release, opening, retreat, transit to blue, blue closure and initial lift.
handoff.successor_readiness: Switch after observed red stability and open/clear fingers; later switch through blue initial lift is supervised. Preserve two-frame causal history.

heuristic.limitations: The representation does not make transport to a fixed buffer invariant to arbitrary red displacement; that mapping is learned from red-to-buffer relation. Stale red pose corrupts decoding. Large shifts can be unreachable or collide. Successful demonstrations do not support recovery after a miss, drop or collision. Prefer the destination prior for moved-buffer placement and the causal residual prior for unusual intermediate TCP entries.
heuristic.pipeline_implications: build_inputs makes two red-centric feature frames while retaining scaled Panda qpos/qvel, fingers, TCP/world position and buffer pose. chunk_context freezes current red pose for one chunk. encode_targets maps FK command poses to red-frame translation plus rotation-6D and native gripper; decode_action composes the world pose and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh joints. Standard DiffusionBackbone remains unchanged. Normalize only these authorized labels.
heuristic.rationale: Observed: demo10100 starts red near (-0.355,-0.209), whereas demo10103 starts it near (-0.351,-0.204); at index 40 each commanded TCP is directly above its respective red. Closure is around 100, red and TCP rise together by 120-160, move toward center by 180-220, lower by 240-260 and release by 280. This is evidence of object-relative structure over demonstrated variation, not recovery. Expected benefit: labels inverse(T_red_at_chunk) T_tcp_command remove a chunk-level displacement of red from action labels. This directly covers approach, alignment, closure, lift and the local held-object relation; red-to-buffer conditioning still represents transport. Fresh qpos/qvel and world positions remain because reachability and IK posture are not object-frame invariant.
heuristic.statement: Red-anchored SE(3) policy: learn each TCP target in the currently observed red-block frame, using 6D rotation plus gripper, while conditioning on red-to-buffer/red-to-blue relations and robot state. Prefer when red is displaced but observed and reachable.

assignment.subgoal: From an open, clear gripper with red in the initially blue region, approach red from above, close around it, lift and carry it to the free central area, lower it to the table, open, and retreat. The core responsibility is red-to-buffer relocation. The tail is deliberately extended through approach, grasp, and initial lift of blue so a late handoff remains action-supervised.

check.checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: FK command poses are encoded relative to chunk-start red and decoded by the inverse composition. The check compares world TCP position, rotation and gripper; nonunique IK is allowed, and safe 6D projection only handles degenerate sampled rotations.

contract.cut_relation: All actions in each assigned [0,stop) segment are supervised, including 210-230 actions shared with place_blue from final red lowering/release through retreat, blue closure and initial lift. No cut is trimmed or reassigned.
contract.output_semantics: Each prediction slot is [p_x,p_y,p_z,r6_0..r6_5,gripper], where p is metres and r6 is the first two rotation-matrix columns of the commanded TCP pose expressed in the red pose observed at chunk start. The red anchor is fixed for the sampled chunk. Safe Gram-Schmidt projects r6 to SO(3); exact training labels are unchanged. The local pose is composed to world, then panda_kinematics.solve_ik uses freshly measured qpos. Gripper scalar preserves native sign semantics. Slots represent t-1..t+14 and execution uses slots 1..8.
contract.parameter_semantics: target_object selects current red_pose as the chunk action frame; successor_object selects blue_pose for overlap conditioning; buffer_pose_world is [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz] in world metres and wxyz and identifies the free destination. Training binds [-0.181,0,0.02,1,0,0,0]. Object poses refresh at every replan.
